# filmopen_plugin_host

*Generated by `scripts/package_digest.py`; regenerate, never edit.*

The plug-in runtime (milestone 5.1 plan §3.4–§3.10, Software Specification §6.11): the registry of the plug-ins in the library and the open project, the stock install from the app's bundle, trust and consent, grants, preferred providers, machine settings and storage (`<app support>/plugins/<tag>/`), and the calls — each through `filmopen_js`'s `runJs`, one at a time per plug-in and five in the app — with every door of `ctx` answered here: `http` with the credential added at the door, `keys`, `project.*`, `ai.complete`, `storage.*`, `asset`, `log`, `progress`, `call`. **The plug-in is chosen by the model** asked for (milestone 5-2b), a render's request prepared once, and **every answer of a function of the contract held to the interface definition** before the app reads it. A transform's entities are written as new versions under `<viewer>.<tag>` with their batch; a render's outputs are downloaded and imported as takes. Every call a person starts keeps a usage ledger (`usage_chain.dart`).

**Flutter.** 22 files, 6,060 lines under `lib/`; 334 tests in 16 files. Barrel: `lib/filmopen_plugin_host.dart`.
